name: axiom-axioma
description: Colors the few phrases in Claude's reply that deserve a second look, and shows an advisory card before a send, spend, spin or scrub call. Advice only, never consent.

theme.title: Signal theme
theme.description: dark for a dark terminal, light for a light one. The plugin cannot see your theme.

palette.title: Signal palette
palette.description: default (traffic colors), cvd (color-vision-safe) or none (style and words only).

words.title: Words beside marks
words.description: always: the word (stop, caution, go, second look) follows every marked phrase. plain_only: only where color is switched off.

workspace.title: Workspace folder (optional)
workspace.description: Absolute path. A remove or move that stays inside this folder skips the scrub card. Leave empty and every remove or move gets a card.
